source: SCP v0.5.6 CellStatPlot / StatPlot (R/SCP-plot.R), commit b9b0eb7a7bf2c2c4b2262e73e09d7ebd515c7da0

input_columns.cell: cell identifier; unique within the figure
input_columns.Ductal: logical membership: CellType in Ductal / Ngn3 low EP / Ngn3 high EP
input_columns.Endocrine: logical membership: CellType in Pre-endocrine / Endocrine
input_columns.G1S: logical membership: Phase in G1 / S

params.stat_type: count (forced by upstream StatPlot for venn; percent requested in the call)

provenance.data: pancreas_sub example, 1000 cells; four logical membership columns derived from CellType and Phase; set sizes 488/512/923/77
provenance.code: native SCP StatPlot venn ggplot construction extracted line-for-line; count/intersection table separated; ggVennDiagram >= 1.4 sf-geometry compatibility patch documented in PATCHES.md
